# Maintaining the wiki

Select the requested mode; read [access](references/access.md) and only the
references relevant to that mode. Treat `` as the request when the host
has not substituted it.

- **Health, structural defects or backlog counts:** [health](references/health.md)
  and [metrics](references/maintenance.md). Reporting does not process clippings.
- **Freshness and what needs factual review:** [freshness](references/stale.md).
- **Consistency, contradictions, unsupported quotes and factual fixes:**
  [lint](references/lint.md) and [evidence](references/evidence.md).
  For quotation-pairing and style-flag mechanics, read the
  [content lint contract](../../README.md#content-lint).
- **Broken citations or integrity worklist repairs:** [repair](references/repair.md).
- **Useful relationships, forward links, orphan navigation and task maps:**
  [relink](references/relink.md) and [identity and relationships](references/efficacy.md).
- **Clipping failures, fidelity flags, declines and human decisions:**
  [triage](references/triage.md). Presenting the UI creates only local session
  state; applying dispositions is a separate action. Before applying re-clips or
  quarantine, read [re-clipping and quarantine](../../docs/reclipping.md).
- **Native Obsidian mechanics when a maintenance step needs them:**
  [Obsidian commands](references/obsidian-cli.md). Requested app actions also
  route here from wiki-user; ordinary file work does not require the app.

Health, freshness and preview reports do not open operations, log, commit or
refresh indexes. Before applying authorized changes, read
[evidence](references/evidence.md) and [operation completion](references/operations.md).
Keep reports distinct from mutations; a request for a report does not authorize
repairs. Preserve raw bodies and foreign edits, validate the actual changed
paths, and finish scoped publication unless the user holds it. Purge keeps its
separate plan and publication approvals in [wiki-purge](../wiki-purge/SKILL.md).

A clean graph does not prove factual accuracy. During substantive maintenance,
use cheap structural checks and a bounded review of changed or high-use pages;
skip an empty vault and avoid a full lint of an unchanged wiki. Preserve factual
review dates on mechanical edits and report coverage limits. For cross-mode
orientation only, see the [workflow overview](references/workflows.md).

vault layout. Read local `AGENTS.md` and schema before edits. A known root and
filesystem access are sufficient for the supported operations below; do not ask

holds maintained pages; `moc/` holds navigational maps; `log/` holds one file per

synthesizing, read [evidence](evidence.md).

diagnostics describe coverage, not relevance: a stale index can omit useful pages.
Read current passages and disclose weak or failed channels. Index freshness is
distinct from factual review dates.

| Operation | Channel and fallback |
|---|---|
| Read a Markdown page or source | CLI `read path=...`, or read its exact path under the known vault root. |
| Search | Prefer `search.mjs` and inspect its diagnostics. If a channel fails, use available results plus bounded filesystem `rg` over `wiki/` and `moc/`; include `raw/clippings/` only for evidence lookup. State missing channels. |
| Health, evidence routes, identity, relationships, drift coverage | Bundled filesystem helpers work without Obsidian. Do not gate them on `assertRunning`. Drift embeddings still require their backend. |
| Factual freshness report | `stale.mjs` may use CLI discovery or scoped filesystem fallback. Preserve missing-review and coverage diagnostics. |
| Ordinary Markdown creation/editing | Use exact-path filesystem edits even when the CLI is healthy, with the same operation, evidence, schema and validation contract. Read current content before editing; preserve unrelated changes. Never pass a whole note body through `content=`. |
| Small typed property or app actions | Use the guarded CLI entry point below; filesystem property edits remain available with schema validation. |
| Opening a note in the UI, executing an Obsidian/plugin command, app state, live Bases queries | Requires working Obsidian CLI. Report the specific unavailable action; continue independent file work. Do not pretend a filesystem approximation executed an app action. |

For CLI calls use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
or the bundled `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. These share an OS-managed lock across
agent processes, vaults and plugin copies for the same user. Do not launch native
`obsidian` directly or bypass a busy guard; other tools' raw calls are not protected.
The guard waits up to 10 seconds for a turn, then fails without sending a request.
Command execution has its own 10-second default timeout. Each request is limited
to a conservative 2,048-byte UTF-8 JSON envelope and rejects physical CR/LF/NUL.
This policy is not Obsidian's documented maximum. If rejected before sending,
use filesystem Markdown editing or narrow the read query; do not split a note
into many CLI writes or disable the guard. No fallback performs writes implicitly.

loop waiting for the app. **A timed-out mutation has an uncertain outcome.** Read
the exact target and check the intended effect before retrying or switching to

content directories; exclude `.recycle/`, dot folders, dependency trees and binary
originals. Do not recursively enumerate the entire user profile or scan a recycled
topic. Raw bodies remain immutable even during fallback. If target content changed

notation. Replace the placeholder with the actual installed absolute path before
execution, and set the vault for the operation's scope. Do not execute literal

```powershell

try {
  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = 'C:/absolute/path/to/vault'
```

1	# Domain workflow reference
2	
3	Read this overview only when comparing workflows. Each mode links its complete
4	procedure; it is not a prerequisite for a search.
5	
6	## Workflows
7	- **Ingest** ([researcher ingestion](../../wiki-researcher/references/ingest.md)): read the source → write/update `wiki/sources/<slug>.md`
8	  (summary + `sources: ["[[raw link]]"]`) → update the entities/concepts it touches
9	  (create stubs where missing) → add `[[links]]` both directions → regenerate the
10	  catalog (`node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/index-gen.mjs"`) → write the log entry via `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/log-entry.mjs"`.
11	  Update only pages the source substantively changes. Set `reviewed` only where factual claims were checked against the evidence; mechanical edits preserve it.
12	  **Prefer a named source set over the bare "process all new clippings" form.**
13	  Two sessions sharing a vault is normal, and ingest is not concurrency-safe:
14	  both would rewrite the same concept and index pages, last write silently wins.
15	  Scoping to what you clipped keeps sessions out of each other's work.
16	  **When a source discusses a concept that already has a page, revise that page
17	  rather than adding a parallel one** — accumulating per-concept is what makes the
18	  wiki compound instead of sprawl.
19	- **Search** ([user search](../../wiki-user/references/search.md)): pure retrieval — find matching `wiki/` pages
20	  (and, with `--include-raw`, `raw/` clippings too) and return citation-ready
21	  `path:line` results. No synthesis, no writes; use this whenever you just
22	  need to locate something, not answer a question.
23	- **Query** ([user query](../../wiki-user/references/query.md)): calls user search → synthesize with citations →
24	  file back only when authorized, or offer a substantive new answer for filing.
25	- **Lint** ([maintainer lint](lint.md)): run [health](health.md) first (cheap); then read the flagged
26	  pages and look for contradictions, stale claims, missing concept pages, and
27	  missing cross-references; run drift. Report; apply only safe fixes or propose the rest.
28	- **Relink** ([maintainer relink](relink.md)): add inferred `[[links]]`; materialize entities
29	  referenced ≥3× but unwritten after checking canonical identity; build/refresh MOCs. Prefer real wikilinks so they
30	  become part of Obsidian's index.
31	- **Authoring** (`wiki/authored/`; [user authoring](../../wiki-user/references/authoring.md)): write these
32	  directly — there is no source to ingest from. Place the file per the
33	  canonical table in [authoring](../../wiki-user/references/authoring.md); use `_templates/authored-note.md`
34	  (`_templates/authored-decision.md` for an ADR,
35	  `_templates/authored-backlog-item.md` for a backlog item), set
36	  `type: authored` and `sources: []`, and record `ai-generated` honestly
37	  (`true` if you drafted it, `false` if the human did). Set `project:`/`kind:`
38	  matching the folder — see that reference for the
39	  vocabulary. Treat it as a living page like any other: revise it in place as
40	  it evolves, set `updated` for edits and `reviewed` only after verifying the factual content or project behavior, and never invent a `raw/` counterpart
41	  to satisfy the provenance guardrail — the disclosure *is* satisfying it. Run
42	  `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/moc-authored-gen.mjs" --apply` after adding a page to a
43	  project with two or more — it regenerates that project's `moc/<project>.md`
44	  hub from `project:`/`kind:`, the same fenced-region contract `index.md`
45	  itself uses, so the hub can never silently fall out of sync with the files.
46	  For a backlog item specifically, also run
47	  `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/backlog-gen.mjs" --apply` — it regenerates
48	  `<project>/roadmap.md`'s itemized list from `backlog/*.md`, the same fence
49	  contract, so the roadmap view can never drift from what the items actually
50	  say.
51

# Domain workflow reference

Read this overview only when comparing workflows. Each mode links its complete
procedure; it is not a prerequisite for a search.

## Workflows
- **Ingest** ([researcher ingestion](../../wiki-researcher/references/ingest.md)): read the source → write/update `wiki/sources/<slug>.md`
  (summary + `sources: ["[[raw link]]"]`) → update the entities/concepts it touches
  (create stubs where missing) → add `[[links]]` both directions → regenerate the
  catalog (`node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/index-gen.mjs"`) → write the log entry via `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/log-entry.mjs"`.
  Update only pages the source substantively changes. Set `reviewed` only where factual claims were checked against the evidence; mechanical edits preserve it.
  **Prefer a named source set over the bare "process all new clippings" form.**
  Two sessions sharing a vault is normal, and ingest is not concurrency-safe:
  both would rewrite the same concept and index pages, last write silently wins.
  Scoping to what you clipped keeps sessions out of each other's work.
  **When a source discusses a concept that already has a page, revise that page
  rather than adding a parallel one** — accumulating per-concept is what makes the
  wiki compound instead of sprawl.
- **Search** ([user search](../../wiki-user/references/search.md)): pure retrieval — find matching `wiki/` pages
  (and, with `--include-raw`, `raw/` clippings too) and return citation-ready
  `path:line` results. No synthesis, no writes; use this whenever you just
  need to locate something, not answer a question.
- **Query** ([user query](../../wiki-user/references/query.md)): calls user search → synthesize with citations →
  file back only when authorized, or offer a substantive new answer for filing.
- **Lint** ([maintainer lint](lint.md)): run [health](health.md) first (cheap); then read the flagged
  pages and look for contradictions, stale claims, missing concept pages, and
  missing cross-references; run drift. Report; apply only safe fixes or propose the rest.
- **Relink** ([maintainer relink](relink.md)): add inferred `[[links]]`; materialize entities
  referenced ≥3× but unwritten after checking canonical identity; build/refresh MOCs. Prefer real wikilinks so they
  become part of Obsidian's index.
- **Authoring** (`wiki/authored/`; [user authoring](../../wiki-user/references/authoring.md)): write these
  directly — there is no source to ingest from. Place the file per the
  canonical table in [authoring](../../wiki-user/references/authoring.md); use `_templates/authored-note.md`
  (`_templates/authored-decision.md` for an ADR,
  `_templates/authored-backlog-item.md` for a backlog item), set
  `type: authored` and `sources: []`, and record `ai-generated` honestly
  (`true` if you drafted it, `false` if the human did). Set `project:`/`kind:`
  matching the folder — see that reference for the
  vocabulary. Treat it as a living page like any other: revise it in place as
  it evolves, set `updated` for edits and `reviewed` only after verifying the factual content or project behavior, and never invent a `raw/` counterpart
  to satisfy the provenance guardrail — the disclosure *is* satisfying it. Run
  `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/moc-authored-gen.mjs" --apply` after adding a page to a
  project with two or more — it regenerates that project's `moc/<project>.md`
  hub from `project:`/`kind:`, the same fenced-region contract `index.md`
  itself uses, so the hub can never silently fall out of sync with the files.
  For a backlog item specifically, also run
  `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/backlog-gen.mjs" --apply` — it regenerates
  `<project>/roadmap.md`'s itemized list from `backlog/*.md`, the same fence
  contract, so the roadmap view can never drift from what the items actually
  say.

- I did not resolve or inspect any vault, run any command or script, or change anything.
